name: Enhanced Capacity
body:
Your capacity for channeling akasha allows you to maintain more essence in a single veil.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15 or veilweaver level 7th.

Benefit(s): When you shape your veils for the day, choose one essence receptacle such as a veil, magic item designed to contain essence, or class feature. Your essence capacity for that receptacle is increased by 1. Each time you shape your veils, you can change the receptacle that benefits from this feat.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. For each time you take this feat, you can apply its effects to one additional receptacle while shaping. You can’t apply this feat’s effects more than once to the same receptacle.
